teaser.en: Its name comes from upesi, 'quickly', because few trees fill a forest gap faster.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na upesi, kwa sababu ni miti michache inayojaza pengo la msitu kwa haraka kuliko huu.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinakula kpwa *upesi*, 'haraka', kpwa sababu ni mihi michache inayomera haraka kuriko uwo phatu phereru tsakani.

summary.en: *Mpesi*, the pigeonwood or charcoal tree, is a fast-growing pioneer of forest gaps, clearings and fallow land. It supplies poles, firewood and charcoal, and its bark and leaves are used for deworming and cough.
summary.sw: *Mpesi* ni mti waanzilishi unaokua haraka katika mapengo ya misitu, maeneo yaliyosafishwa na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Hutoa nguzo, kuni na mkaa, na gome na majani yake hutumika kutoa minyoo na kutibu kikohozi.
summary.dg: *Mpesi* (kpwa Chingereza *pigeonwood* au *charcoal tree*) ni muhi unaokula haraka, kahi ya mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu phereru tsakani, phatu ambapho mihi ikakatwa na minda iriyorichwa. Unalavya nguzo, kuni na makala, na gophare na makodzage nkuhumirwa kuusa minyololo bindoni na kpwa atu anaokolola.

about.en: *Mpesi* is a shrub or tree up to 12 metres tall with drooping branchlets. The leaves are rough, with toothed edges, and their bases are lopsided. The fruits are tiny and black, and birds spread them widely, which helps the tree reach new clearings.
about.sw: *Mpesi* ni kichaka au mti wenye urefu wa hadi mita 12 na vitawi vinavyoinama chini. Majani yake yanakwaruza, yana kingo zenye meno, na sehemu zake za chini hazilingani pande mbili. Matunda ni madogo sana na meusi, na ndege huyasambaza mbali, jambo linalousaidia mti kufika kwenye maeneo mapya yaliyosafishwa.
about.dg: *Mpesi* ni chitsaka au muhi wa hadi mita kumi na mbiri, wenye panda ndide zinazobwadzika. Makodza ganakaraza, genye kanda dza meno ga msumeno, na photsi ya chila kodza uphande mwenga ni mre kuriko wanjina. Matunda ni madide sana na ni maru, na nyuni nkugatawanya kure; kpwa hivyo muhi unaphaha kufika phatu phereru phaphya.

where.en: It is a pioneer: one of the first trees to grow in forest gaps, clearings and fallow fields. Anywhere land has been cleared and left, look for its quick young stands.
where.sw: Ni mti waanzilishi: mmojawapo wa miti ya kwanza kuota katika mapengo ya misitu, maeneo yaliyosafishwa na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Popote ambapo ardhi imesafishwa na kuachwa, tafuta vikundi vyake vichanga vinavyochipuka haraka.
where.dg: Ni muhi wa kpwandza: kahi ya mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu phereru tsakani, phatu ambapho mihi ikakatwa na minda iriyorichwa. Phophosi ambapho mihi ikakatwa na tsi ikarichwa, endza makundi ga mihiye mitsanga inayomera haraka.

uses.en:
The wood is used for poles, firewood and charcoal, which is where the English name 'charcoal tree' comes from. The tree also gives shade.

The bark and leaves are used in traditional medicine for deworming and for cough.
uses.sw:
Mbao hutumika kwa nguzo, kuni na mkaa, na ndiko jina la Kiingereza *charcoal tree*, yaani 'mti wa mkaa', linakotokea. Mti huu pia hutoa kivuli.

Gome na majani hutumika katika tiba ya jadi kutoa minyoo na kutibu kikohozi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, kuni na makala, na ndiko kunakokula dzina ra Chingereza *charcoal tree*. Muhi piya unapha pepho.

Gopha na makodza nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji kuusa minyololo bindoni na kpwa atu anaokolola.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name *mpesi* as coming from *upesi*, 'quickly', because the tree grows so fast.
culture.sw: Pakia inaeleza kuwa jina *mpesi* linatokana na *upesi*, kwa sababu mti huu hukua haraka mno.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala dzina *mpesi* rinakula kpwa *upesi*, 'haraka', kpwa sababu muhi uhu unakula haraka sana.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mpesi* and *mbonobono*; the ICRAF handbook also gives *mbonobono*, a name it uses as well for the orange-milk tree, *mkonotsaka*. In Swahili it is *mpesi*, and in Giriama *mzunguzungu*. In English it is pigeonwood or the charcoal tree.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mpesi* na *mbonobono*; kitabu cha ICRAF pia kinatoa *mbonobono*, jina ambalo kinalitumia pia kwa mti wa utomvu wa rangi ya machungwa, *mkonotsaka*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mpesi*, na kwa Kigiriama *mzunguzungu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pigeonwood* au *charcoal tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mpesi* na *mbonobono*; chitabu cha ICRAF piya chinapha *mbonobono*, dzina ambaro chinarihumira piya kpwa *mkonotsaka*, muhi wenye maziya ga rangi ya chungbwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mpesi*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mzunguzungu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pigeonwood* au *charcoal tree*.

reason.sw: Mti waanzilishi mwenzake, unaoitwa pia mbonobono
reason.dg: Nao piya ni muhi wa kpwandza, unaoihwa piya *mbonobono*

reason.sw: Pia hutumika dhidi ya minyoo ya tumboni
reason.dg: Nao piya nkuhumirwa kuusa minyololo bindoni

reason.en: Also used for firewood and charcoal
reason.sw: Pia hutumika kwa kuni na mkaa
reason.dg: Nao piya nkuhumirwa kpwa kuni na makala
Muhi ambao atu nkuhepa kuutsoma dza kuni
